name: Mobility Plus Boise
old_description: Mobility products play a vital role in the lives of many people, offering enhanced independence and freedom of movement. Whether you need mobility aids due to age-related issues, temporary injuries, or disabilities, At Mobility Plus Boise we got it all!
about:
Mobility Plus Boise operates from a storefront at 339 North Milwaukee Street in Boise, Idaho. The business is locally owned and operated; online reviews identify Brian and Wendy as the proprietors who manage day-to-day operations. A founding year is not disclosed on the company's website.

The company sells, rents, and services mobility equipment including scooters, power chairs, lift chairs, stair lifts, wheelchairs, rollators, and adaptive aids. Inventory covers both new units from brands such as Jazzy and pre-owned equipment that undergoes inspection before resale. Services include white-glove delivery, professional setup, and ongoing repair support. The Boise location is open Tuesday through Saturday, 11 a.m. to 7 p.m.

Customers range from seniors and individuals recovering from temporary injuries to people with permanent disabilities. Commercial clients include in-home personal trainers and care facilities that refer patients for equipment fitting. The staff works directly with end users and with caregivers coordinating from out of state.

Mobility Plus emphasizes its local presence, personalized guidance, and competitive pricing with frequent promotions. The company states that every product—new or used—passes a rigorous quality check for safety and functionality, and that its team provides expert recommendations tailored to each customer's needs.
